largestDefects: hero camera clipped the upper crown
near-black sparse foliage let the procedural branch scaffold dominate
flat moss islands and exposed root tips weakened ground contact
reviewRounds.change: reframed all full-tree cameras, increased and brightened fan coverage, simplified the ground treatment, and buried root tips
reviewRounds.result: the complete crown and root relationship fits; leaf mass reads from the hero distance; ground contact is quieter

largestDefects: crowded close-up did not clearly prove the fan notch or veins
late review shadow submission exceeded the 40-call budget
reviewRounds.change: added an isolated proof state from the same leaf/vein/short-shoot/petiole modules and removed low-value fine shadow casters
reviewRounds.result: species identity is inspectable; final hero submission is 38 calls and 301888 frame triangles; neutral view preserves material evidence

limitations: generic art-directed specimen rather than reference-faithful reconstruction
leaf dimensions are deliberately enlarged for hero-view readability
wind is hierarchical procedural motion rather than solved branch dynamics
single hero LOD is not intended for a forest or mobile reuse
